balls.text: on the bounce to deep midwicket! And David pinches two in no time! He drags his bat back, even as Inglis' attempt at clipping the stumps fails. David had hoicked this length ball across the line and sprinted, and they successfully got two. Also, that was David's fifty

over cover! David fights a lone battle on taking RCB to 92 in a 14-over game. Wait, wait... it's not over yet!! It's a no-ball by Brar! Anyway, he bowled this full and outside off, as David sent the ball flat and hard with an aerial slash
big six over deep square leg! Brar bowls on the shorter side, and goes outside leg. David gets his front leg out of the way, and clubs this for a six where the ball was sent miles up in the air
pings the roof! He finally connects, and launches this fullish ball around sixth stump over long-off
on the bounce to deep midwicket moving to his left. Another dot! Arm ball on a length on the stumps, and David had a heave again
doesn't run again, as he swings across the line at this full and quick ball on off. The ball dribbles away to deep midwicket
this is full, and on the stumps as it dips on to him. He has a punch, but gets an inside edge behind square
he gets the single off the last ball of the over, as he gets across the stumps, and dives this low full toss wide-ish of off to long-off
full and wide of off, and he reaches out to drive to deep extra cover. They don't take the single, though
four more to deep square leg! How far can he take RCB? Another short delivery from Bartlett, and this comes just below David's shoulder, and outside off. David pulls powerfully for four
slower ball, and on a short of a length. It arrives around sixth stump, and David rides the bounce to swat it to deep-backward point for two
one-bounce four over square leg! David is deep in the crease, and clatters this length delivery just outside off with his front leg out of the way. Four crucial runs for RCB
full and on middle and off. Driven to long-off, and of course they don't run
Brar bowls fullish and wide of off, and Hazlewood goes back to block it down

given lbw first ball! Struck on the front pad, and that hardly took a while before the umpire's finger went up. Brar on a hat-trick! On the fuller side of a length on middle and off, and angled in from around the wicket. The ball seemed to be going on with the angle, as it beat Dayal's attempted defence on the inside edge

Bartlett almost overran that! He was placed a good few steps in at long-off, and even then he seemed to have walked forward a bit too much. The ball arrived above his head, and he eventually took it with a reverse cup while adjusting himself back. Bhuvi lofted at this full delivery around off, and got the height, but not the power and the distance
lofted to deep extra cover! Fuller still, and just outside off, as Bhuvi clears his front leg and finds the gap wide of long-off with a free swing of the arms
fuller and quicker, and on off. Pushed towards short midwicket
angled in on a fullish length on off, and turning away. Punched back towards Brar
a swipe to fine leg, as Bhuvi gets slightly across at this short ball rising on leg. He does well to get on top of the bounce there
short of a length on the stumps, and punched to long-off

driven to deep extra cover, and Shashank does well running and sliding to his right from deep cover. It was a slower ball from Arshdeep, who went full and just outside off. David waited before driving hard and all along the ground
flayed away over backward point! Arshdeep goes wide-ish of off after angling this across, but he hits a comfortable length for David to reach out and have a liberal slash for four
angling across, and on a length around off. David pushes on the bounce to mid-off

pulled to long leg! David is RCB's only hope if they are to put up a competitive score. He gets a short ball on leg from Arshdeep, and swivels and pulls between the fielders at a straightish fine leg and deep square leg
fuller and quicker on off, and punched to deep cover
the googly! This dips on a length just outside off, and finishes around middle, before Bhuvi pushes forward aerially to the left of the man at short midwicket. Single to long-on
ohh, slower still from Chahal, who goes full on middle at 74kph. Blocked on off side by Bhuvi
quite full, and tossed up on the stumps. Pushed towards the man at short midwicket
this dips on a full length around off, and hints to turn away. It is punched hard to deep-backward point after shifting his weight back
full and dipping, and just outside off. Driven to long-on by getting to the pitch of the ball
short in length, and wide of off. Bhuvi slaps to deep cover by playing away from himself
on a length, and just outside off. The ball straightened away, and was dabbed down towards cover
slightly fuller than the previous ball, but still on the shorter side. It pitches on off, and ends on leg to hit Bhuvi's front pad as he looked to clip. The ball trickled towards point
short in length, and angling in. It pitches just outside off, and finishes closer to off, as Bhuvi pushes towards cover

confident appeal for lbw by Jansen... and the umpire's finger goes up after a while! Bhandage reviews, though. He looked to flick it, but almost with a half-closed face of the bat, and in an awkward position - his feet were almost one behind the other there. It was a length delivery on from Jansen, and as Bhandage looked to clip it away, he missed. Ball tracking shows the ball would have gone on to clip the side of leg stump on umpire's call
full ball swinging into off, and pushed back on the bounce to Jansen

just clears Chahal! The bowler leapt with his right hand up, but the ball barely beat it. Chahal had slowed it down, and went fuller and straighter, as Bhandage chipped it back aerially. Single down the ground
wide of the crease from Chahal, who goes on the shorter side of a length around sixth stump. The ball tuns in, and is pushed towards cover

taken at long-off! Things are unravelling for RCB, as Patidar departs after being dismissed by Chinnaswamy's own Chahal. He went fullish and got it to dip around off, as Patidar made room and looked to loft. He seemed to go inside out, but couldn't place it beyond the reach of Bartlett, who moved to his left to grab the ball
ohh, this was tossed up, and full and outside off on a full length. David cleared his front leg, and ended up swiping to long-off
fuller and on middle, as David goes back to nudge towards midwicket
on a length, as this dips around middle. It turns away and finishes on off, and is pushed to long-on

Bumped in short around leg, David gets out of the way. Wide not given. David consults with Patidar and reviews it. RCB won't mind this break in play. It's been at breakneck speed so far, and they need to regroup. Ball tracking shows that was going under his head if he was standing upright at the crease. RCB lose a review
David looks to cut away this short and wide delivery but gets an inside edge onto the ground and through to Inglis
Back of length around leg, tucked behind square leg off his hips
On a length around leg, David stands tall to prod it past the bowler

Well, David looks unfazed by what's going on around him! Short ball on middle sits up nicely and he swats it away with a pull in front of square leg. The deep fielder was sprinting across but he placed that very well

And another one bites the dust! But wait, did that come off the helmet? PBKS review it immediately. Banged in short and angled into Krunal, who looks to pull. Had no idea where that was. The ball looped up to Krunal's left and Jansen ran up to grab that. Were there two noises? There's a spike as the ball goes past bat Krunal Pandya, who was getting his concussion test done, will also have to walk back to the dugout!
Tossed up full, Krunal works it out to deep square leg

This one does carry! Jitesh didn't have any control on that as he looks to slog-sweep this full ball around middle. That drifted in to pitch on middle and it takes the top edge. Deep square leg runs in and takes a good catch. PBKS have been excellent in the field today, and Chahal has his first of the evening!
Drops safely! It's a bit short and Patidar rocks back to pull. Ends up skying it but doesn't carry to the deep midwicket fielder
Floated full on middle, Jitesh eases it square on the off side for a single
Tossed up full outside off, pushed out towards point
Full and dipping on middle, Patidar looks to slog it away but it comes off the bottom half of the bat to deep midwicket's left
Beaten again! This time Jitesh goes across the stumps and looks to slash it away but can't connect
Goes past the outside edge! Back of length around leg and it zips across Jitesh who hung his bat out to fend
Full outside off, Patidar hits it hard to mid-off's left, but can't beat the fielder
Length ball angled across, he runs it down to deep third
On a length around middle and leg, Jitesh defends
Short ball angled across, Patidar runs it down to deep third

Skied again, and taken! Bartlett gets his first! This is full outside off, Livingstone comes down the track to heave it away and it gets a big leading edge. Goes high in the sky in front of point. Priyansh Arya at cover backtracks, and that's another good catch taken by Punjab Kings!
On a length outside off, tapped towards short third
Beats the point fielder! On a length outside off and Livingstone plays a firm square drive. The fielder dove to his right but can't stop that
Livingstone looks to drive this full ball straight down the ground, but hits it too close to Bartlett and he manages to stop it
Full on the stumps, Patidar flicks it out to deep square leg
ON a length outside off, Patidar punches it back out to the bowler's left. Got that off the bottom half of the bat onto the ground
Length ball around middle and off, punched to mid-off. Excellent start from Arshdeep
Yorker outside off sneaks past Livingstone! He tried to get his bat down with an open face, but can't connect

Jansen holds on tracking back! Length ball angled across and Kohli looks to go downtown. He ends up slicing it and Jansen from mid-on has to track back some ways, but does very well to not make a mess of that. Crowd goes silent as Kohli walks back to the dugout
Length ball angled across, he steers it towards short third for a quick run
Dug in short and Kohli pulls it to the midwicket fielder's right. Huge roar as Koach gets his first run
Full around middle, Kohli nudges it back towards the bowler

Excellent shot, but not the reward he would want! This is full outside off and he launches it over mid-on. The ball lands short of the boundary and just stops! They only get two there! The mid-on fielder hadn't even bothered to run after that ball at first!
Glorious! Patidar gets the first six of the day. This is in the slot on off and he whips it over square leg. Excellent pickup shot
Full outside off, Patidar lofts it over point with the open face. Clears the infielder but can't beat deep backward point running to his right
Length ball around off, clipped to midwicket
Beauty! Back of length delivery that veers away past the outside edge as Patidar looks to push to the off side
Short of good length around off, Patidar drops it in front on the leg side and wants a single but Kohli sends him back
Length ball on leg, seaming away, much like the one that got Salt, but Patidar is happy to just tuck it square for a single

And the RCB skipper is off the blocks quickly! This is full and swinging into him on middle. Patidar just clips it off his toes between midwicket and mid-on. Infielders gave chase, but the ball raced away. Lovely balance

Skies it and that's an excellent catch from Inglis! Shorter side of good length around leg, it seams away as Salt looks to swing it leg side. Takes a top edge and goes high to his left. Inglis has a long way to run, almost to Chahal at square leg and dives forward to hold on!
Full on middle, swinging in. Salt keeps it out
On a length around leg, Salt defends

Punched down the ground! The crowd erupts as Salt starts off with a handsome boundary. This is pitched up and gets a hint of swing away from the left-hander. Pitches around middle and leg and it's creamed back pas t the bowler

flayed away wide of long-on! PBKS win by five wickets! A length delivery from Dayal, which angled across, and arrived on off or thereabouts. Stoinis got his front leg out of the way, and swung hard to wrap this game up
and this boundary will make more of the fans depart! Wadhera slashes this shortish ball arriving outside off to play to deep extra cover, as he shifts his weight back to dispatch the ball
swiped over fine leg! This could be it. A short-of-a-length ball on leg, and he stays deep in the crease to pull that flat and hard in between the two teams' dugout
off the outside edge, but to deep third. On a good length around middle, and straightening away. Stoinis had a jab, but wasn't in control of that

taken at long-on! Salt takes this one almost too casually. PBKS are ensuring that this goes deeper than they would like. Bhuvi bowled on a short of a length on off, and the ball seamed back in to finish on middle. The bounce was a bit too much for that attempted loft from Shashank, who went ahead with the shot. But the ball ballooned for a simple catch at long-on, as RCB strike back again
comes down the pitch, and swipes this shortish ball on middle to deep-backward square leg
angles this across, and goes on the shorter side of a length on off. Dabbed to point
fuller and flatter, and just outside off. Tapped towards point for a single
another miss! Fuller and around sixth stump, and this shapes to turn away, as Wadhera looked to sweep but was beaten
slower, and beaten! Suyash goes on a length just outside off, and the ball straightens. Wadhera looked to push but was beaten
drilled between extra cover and cover! Full and outside off, and this was absolutely crushed for four more
turns away, and four! PBKS are running away with this now. That was angled in, and landed on a footmark just outside off. It turned away sharply, and beat the outside edge as he looked to drive
bam! Into the first tier over long-off! Wadhera vs Suyash is turning out to be one-sided. It was a length ball angling across and arriving outside off, as Wadhera leaned into a big loft for six

beaten! Hazlewood ends his spell with nearly another wicket. He goes on the shorter side, and slightly wide of off. Shashank has a jab at it, but the ball shapes away after pitching, and goes past his bat
on the shorter side of a length on leg, and it takes his pad as he looks to swipe. The ball rolls towards square leg

massive bounce for Hazlewood!! The bowler gives Wadhera a stare, and has a word for him too. Short of a length on middle, as Wadhera skipped down and looked to hook but missed. The ball took off before Jitesh grabbed it
he sees Shashank hinting to walk down, and bowls on a shorter side of a length around sixth stump. Slapped to deep-backward point to get off the mark
on a length, and in the corridor just outside off. The ball straightens after pitching, and is dabbed towards point
On a fullish length, and just outside off. Pushed to mid-on, as he leans into the shot
whipped over midwicket! These two hits bring PBKS back into the game! Suyash went on a length this time, and around off. Wadhera went across the line, and dispatched it for another forceful hit
reverse swept over backward point! Full and straight, and Wahdera switched his wrists early to hit hard and high for four. Very powerful and convincing hit there

stumped?! No, I don't think so. Jitesh whipped the bails off as Wadhera looked to reverse sweep this full and wide-ish ball but missed. Then, as Wadhera seemed to lose his balance and fall on his back, Jitesh destroyed the stumps, but in vain
beaten! Another wrong 'un, as this pitches on a length on middle, and turns away to finish just outside off. Wahdera looked to defend, but the ball went past his outside edge
fuller and around sixth stump. Another one angles across, as Wadhera looks to drive but misses
Suyash is animated in appealing for lbw, but it's turned down! It seemed to be pitching outside leg, though. Yup, replays confirm that. Wadhera looked clip at this length ball but missed the googly

gone!! Another one for Hazlewood int this over! RCB can suddenly sniff something out of this game. Hazlewood bowls on the shorter side again, and around that seventh-stump line. There was, yet again, some extra bounce for him, though. Inglish went hacking at this ball seeing the width, but the ball flew off his bat to deep third, where Suyash settled under the ball for a comfortable catch
angled across from over the wicket, and on a fullish length around sixth stump. Tapped towards point for a quick single

well taken by Jitesh! He had to jump full stretch, and gobble it with both gloves. Hazlewood gets extra bounce again in this over, and the ball takes off from the top edge of Iyer's bat. Hazlewood bowled on a short of a length, and in the channel just outside off. Iyer saw that and went slashing, only to get an edge, and the ball flying behind
fuller length, and angling in. It pitches on middle and off, and finishes on middle. Pushed back to Hazlewood by Iyer
extra bounce off a length for Hazlewood, who bowls just outside off. Cut away by Inglis to deep third
Iyer opens the face of the bat at this short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump, and jabs it towards deep third
Tossed full on leg, eased to deep fine leg
On a length on middle, pushed down to long-on
Suyash throws this one wide, Inglis looks to drive this away but is beaten!
Too full on leg, Iyer whips it out to deep midwicket on the bounce
Googly around off, tucked to midwicket
Wrong'un on a length outside off, pushed to point
Whipped out to wide long-on
Pushes this out to backward point
Full outside off and this one turns sharply off the surface and goes to the keeper. Inglis did well to not prod at that
Too short from Krunal again and now Inglis slaps it away between deep cover and long-off
Hammered into the gap! That's a poor ball from Pandya and Inglis punishes him. Too short and that area in front of square leg was completely vacant. Inglis has no problem pulling that away
On a length around middle, Shreyas taps it into the vacant midwicket region and gets a single as Krunal runs to his right to collect
Full and going across, driven straight to the point fielder. Just three runs off that over
On a length around leg, Inglis fends it towards cover. He was starting to take off for a single, but Iyer says no immediately
Length ball pitches around off and goes across Inglis, who is beaten on the cut
On a length around leg, tucked through midwicket for a single
Steers this length ball to deep third
Length ball on leg, fended towards point
Length ball angles down leg. Dayal looks back to appeal for caught behind as Inglis misses his flick. Sees the umpire signalling for wide instead
Length ball outside off, Inglis steers it down to deep third
On a length outside off, he meets it with an open face to glide it to short third

David takes another catch! On a length and angled across, Priyansh Arya looks to heave this away but slices it. Goes up high and towards mid-off. This is a simpler one for David, who is in the thick of things today!
Top edge flies for six! Hazlewood goes short on leg and Priyansh looks to pull. It goes high off the top edge and fine on the leg side. PBKS riding their luck early on!
Length ball angled across, and he square drives it past the cover point fielder. Deep backward point runs across and keeps it down to two
ON a length ouitside off, Shreyas looks to defend. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to his right, they scamper for a quick single
On a length around leg, fended in front on the off side
Full outside off, he runs it fine on the off side to get off the mark with a single

This time he picks out a fielder! Bhuvneshwar pulls back his length and Prabhsimran looks to go downtown again. Slices it high off the toe end and David runs to his right from mid-off and he is as safe a pair of hands as you can ask for. And clearly, David can do no wrong today! Patidar was also running in from mid-on but they manage to not collide as David calls for it early. RCB have their first wicket
Over mid-off now! Another length ball outside off and he goes inside out and gets a one-bounce four
Gets a hold of that! Length ball outside off, swinging away again but he manages to loft this down the ground
Prabhsimran skies it and it lands safe! Outswinger outside off and Prabh looks to swing across the line. Goes high towards deep square leg. Dayal at deep backward square can't get under it in time
Edge flies over the slip fielder! Full outside off and swinging away, Arya looks to drive and gets a thick edge. Kohli is leaping with his arm stretched out high, but it goes over him
On a length around leg and seaming across Prabhsimran. He plays it square on the off side for a single
Now it's the outswinger to Arya, full outside off and he lofts it out to the off side sweeper on the bounce
Dayal misses his line and fires this down leg
Leading edge pops up over the umpire and lands safe. Inswinger on the pads and Prabhsimran looks to work it leg side. Lucky to get away there
Another inswinger, and this time he flicks it away to the deep backward square fielder
Full inswinger outside off, tucked along the ground to the midwicket fielder
Swing and a miss! Prabhsimran comes down the track again and looks to hammer this down the ground but this length ball outside off veers away to beat the toe end
Attempted scoop gone wrong. On a length outside off, Prabhsimran goes across the stumps and looks to launch this over the keeper but misses out and cops a blow on the body
Length ball angled across, he looks to pull and gets it off the inside half to deep backward square's left
Prabhsimran comes down the crease early and Bhuvneshwar shortens his length. Tucked square on the leg side for a single
On a length around middle, tapped towards cover and they take a risky single. Krunal doesn't collect cleanly and the batters make it through safely
Starts with a length ball around leg that Arya parries to the leg side
